name: Montage Big Sky
insider_take: This alpine sanctuary sits at 7,500 feet elevation in the heart of Montana's most pristine wilderness, where endless powder and untamed landscapes create the ultimate mountain escape.
whats_special: Montage Big Sky is the only luxury ski-in/ski-out resort in Big Sky, offering direct access to North America's biggest skiing with over 5,800 acres of terrain. The property features Montana's first Spa Montage and sits beneath Lone Peak, which towers at 11,166 feet. Big Sky boasts an average of 400 inches of annual snowfall and some of the least crowded slopes in the country.
pro_tip: Book your stay during "shoulder season" (late March/early April) for incredible powder conditions, longer daylight hours, and fewer crowds on the mountain's legendary Lone Peak Tram.
dont_miss: The thrilling Lone Peak Tram ride to the summit for 360-degree views of three mountain ranges, and the nearby Yellowstone National Park (just 45 minutes away) where you can spot bison, wolves, and geysers. In summer, the area transforms into a fly-fishing paradise along the Gallatin River.
pros: Direct ski-in/ski-out access to Big Sky Resort slopes
Luxurious mountain resort with full-service spa and wellness facilities
Multiple dining venues featuring locally-sourced Montana cuisine
Year-round outdoor activities including hiking, fishing, and winter sports
cons: Premium pricing reflects luxury mountain resort positioning
Remote mountain location requires travel planning
